Rajasthan.threats_facing: Loss of traditional patronage, competition from modern digital entertainment, and economic hardship for artisan families.
Rajasthan.preservation_strategies: Digitizing performances, organizing heritage festivals, securing government stipends for puppet makers, and integrating cultural workshops into schools.

Kerala.threats_facing: Aging master performers, lack of interest among younger generations, and commercialization altering traditional rituals.
Kerala.preservation_strategies: Establishing institutional academies, offering youth scholarships, documentation of ritual scripts, and sustainable cultural tourism.

Assam.threats_facing: Monsoon flooding eroding Majuli river island, lack of raw materials for traditional masks, and globalization.
Assam.preservation_strategies: Building flood-resistant artisan centers, creating e-commerce platforms for mask sales, and global cultural exchange programs.
